title: Sales Development agent: connect to Salesforce CRM through the Salesforce MCP server
summary: Hold: Microsoft has published Copilot Credit billing for Sales Development Agent resources, beginning on December 1, 2026, so the unpublished-meter statement and cost rating need correction. The claim that every Salesforce permission held by the agent user is reachable through this MCP server is not supported.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A meter, credit rate or price specific to the Sales Development agent is not yet published.
claims.quote: Sales Development Agent and Service Agent ... December 1, 2026 ... Consumption billing begins when each product becomes available. ... a recurring charge of 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month.
claims.fix: Replace the unpublished-meter statements with: 'Microsoft publishes Copilot Credit billing for Sales Development Agent resources in Frontier Public beginning December 1, 2026: 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month for the agent account, email address and persistent Microsoft 365 resources, plus consumption billing for agent activity. The person responsible for the agent must have consumption billing enabled.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-resources-for-agents. Retain the activation page's $0 SKU description as that page's preview guidance; do not imply that the December charges are already active on November 21.

claims.claim: Anything the agent user holds in Salesforce is reachable through this MCP server.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales Development agent" "Salesforce" "MCP" "permissions" all objects. Opened Salesforce integration, overview and architecture; they give required permissions and particular actions, not unrestricted reach across everything the agent user can access.
claims.fix: Remove ', because anything it holds in Salesforce is reachable through the MCP server'. Keep the least-privilege advice, the documented permission list and the separate open question about whose Salesforce permissions apply at runtime.

claims.claim: The medium cost rating describes the documented cost of this capability.
claims.quote: Page: cost: medium; 'a meter specific to this agent is not yet published.' Microsoft: 'All charges are billed consumptively via Copilot Credits'; Sales Development Agent public preview: December 1, 2026.
claims.fix: Set cost to variable under the standard's metered-cost definition. Replace the rationale with: 'Variable. Microsoft publishes Copilot Credit billing for Sales Development Agent resources beginning December 1, 2026, including 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month plus consumption billing for agent activity; Salesforce licensing is also required.' Cite the Microsoft 365 Resources for Agents page and distinguish this upcoming billing from the activation page's $0 preview SKU.

claims.claim: Every control that the governance checklist instructs readers to configure or check appears in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Copilot > Settings > Copilot Frontier'; 'Can use role'; Salesforce profile and field permissions; 'block a single instance'; 'Disconnect Salesforce'. Table: creation audience and organisation-wide blocking only.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist instructions to set Salesforce profile/field permissions, check Copilot Frontier and user Frontier access, share the connection/check Can use, block an individual instance, and disconnect Salesforce from Governance guidance. These controls have no table rows; their already documented descriptive guidance can remain elsewhere. Do not add new control rows as part of this correction.
